metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in the area near Banamepe along the Digul River between November 2002 and November 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the Hansen Global Forest Change (UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1.11) global product (no cloud issues) to compare forest cover near the Digul River. Define a point near Banamepe and buffer 15 km. Compute forest in 2002 as treecover2000≥30% minus losses up to 2002. For 2019, use treecover2000≥30% minus losses up to 2019 and add 2000–2012 gain pixels not lost by 2019. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (static product). Use treecover mask/gain/loss to define valid pixels and forest; print pixel counts and areas. 3. Logic for valid zero vs null: If valid pixel count within geometry is 0, output C2. If any reduce result is null/NaN, output C3. Otherwise compare 2019 vs 2002 forest area; if decreased beyond tolerance (max 1% of geom area or 10 ha), answer Yes (A), else No (B). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (near Banamepe along the Digul River; approximate) const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([139.60, -6.10]); const geom = pt.buffer(15000).bounds(); // ~15 km buffer box const areaKm2 = ee.Number(geom.area()).divide(1e6); // 2. Data Acquisition const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1.11'); const tc = gfc.select('treecover2000'); const loss = gfc.select('lossyear'); const gain = gfc.select('gain'); // Forest definition const tcThresh = 30; const forest2000 = tc.gte(tcThresh); // End of 2002: remove loss up to and including 2002 (lossyear 1..2) const lostBy2002 = loss.gt(0).and(loss.lte(2)); const forest2002 = forest2000.and(lostBy2002.not()); // End of 2019: remove loss up to and including 2019 (lossyear 1..19), include gains not lost by 2019 const lostBy2019 = loss.gt(0).and(loss.lte(19)); const forest2019_base = forest2000.and(lostBy2019.not()); const forest2019_gain = gain.eq(1).and(lostBy2019.not()); const forest2019 = forest2019_base.or(forest2019_gain); // Valid mask: use treecover band presence const validMask = tc.mask(); // where data exists // Build bands for one-pass reduction const ones = ee.Image(1); const pix_valid = ones.updateMask(validMask).rename('pix_valid'); const pix_f02 = ones.updateMask(forest2002).rename('pix_f02'); const pix_f19 = ones.updateMask(forest2019).rename('pix_f19'); const area_valid = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).updateMask(validMask).rename('area_valid_ha'); const area_f02 = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).updateMask(forest2002).rename('area_f02_ha'); const area_f19 = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).updateMask(forest2019).rename('area_f19_ha'); const combined = ee.Image.cat([pix_valid, pix_f02, pix_f19, area_valid, area_f02, area_f19]); const sums = combined.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e10 }); const out = sums.getInfo(); const validPix = out ? out.pix_valid : null; const f02Pix = out ? out.pix_f02 : null; const f19Pix = out ? out.pix_f19 : null; const validAreaHa = out ? out.area_valid_ha : null; const f02AreaHa = out ? out.area_f02_ha : null; const f19AreaHa = out ? out.area_f19_ha : null; // 3. Validation const areaKm2Val = areaKm2.getInfo(); if (!out || validPix === null || validAreaHa === null) { console.log('Calculation failed: null results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (validPix === 0 || validAreaHa === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (f02AreaHa === null || f19AreaHa === null || isNaN(f02AreaHa) || isNaN(f19AreaHa)) { console.log('Calculation failed: forest area is null/NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Stats and Decision const deltaHa = f19AreaHa - f02AreaHa; const tolHa = Math.max(0.01 * validAreaHa, 10); // tolerance: 1% of valid area or 10 ha const decreased = deltaHa < -tolHa; // 5. Evidence prints (<=20 lines) console.log('Region area (km2):', areaKm2Val.toFixed(1)); console.log('Valid pixels (~1km):', Math.round(validPix)); console.log('Treecover threshold (%):', tcThresh); console.log('Forest 2002 (ha):', f02AreaHa.toFixed(1), 'pixels:', Math.round(f02Pix || 0)); console.log('Forest 2019 (ha):', f19AreaHa.toFixed(1), 'pixels:', Math.round(f19Pix || 0)); console.log('Change 2019-2002 (ha):', deltaHa.toFixed(1)); console.log('Tolerance (ha):', tolHa.toFixed(1)); // Final tag console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log('Error:', String(err).slice(0, 120)); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
